fno_coreg_residual_notes: H3 hybrid: 4 per-fidelity FNOs (hidden=64, modes=[4,8,12,12], blocks=3) + MFRNP decoder-in-the-aggregation (decoder_hidden=32) + continuous-m basis head (K=10, B(m)=MLP([m,m^2]) zero-init) on HF latent; per-fidelity y-scaler, val_frac=0.1.

comparison.vs_paper_geomean_0.0516: 0.86x paper (0.0442 / 0.0516) -- BEATS paper composite for the first time
comparison.ifc_poisson_vs_paper_0.036: 0.49x paper (0.0742 vs 0.036) -- still misses paper bar
comparison.ifc_heat_H4_0.0999_to_0.0263: 74% improvement on heat (basis head + coregionalization unlocks heat)
comparison.ifc_poisson_H4_0.0596_to_0.0742: -25% regression on poisson (heavier model hurts poisson vs H4's targeted loss-weighting)

evaluator_note: H3 (fno_coreg_residual) is the first model family to push the composite below the paper geomean (0.0442 < 0.0516) and to beat the published ifc_heat bar (0.0263 < 0.074). ifc_poisson regressed vs H4 (0.0742 vs H4's 0.0596) because H4's Poisson-specific loss-weighting was not carried into H3 — combining H3's basis head + coregionalization with H4's loss reweighting is the obvious next move. Eval ran on cuda; sbatch wall ~80 min including queue/startup; training wall <17 min for fno_coreg_residual itself.
